description: Scan for LLM-generated cruft patterns using bash resolver - no LLM needed

task_steps.description: Get list of staged TypeScript files

config.command: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | xargs -r grep -nE 'TODO.*LLM|FIXME.*generated|TODO.*remove' 2>/dev/null || echo 'CLEAN'
git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | xargs -r grep -nE '_unused[A-Z]|_deprecat' 2>/dev/null || echo 'CLEAN'

task_steps.description: Scan for // removed or // DEPRECATED comments

config.command: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | xargs -r grep -nE '// removed|// DEPRECATED|// legacy' 2>/dev/null || echo 'CLEAN'

echo '=== CRUFT SCAN SUMMARY ===' && echo 'Staged files:' && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | wc -l && echo 'Cruft patterns found:' && (git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'TODO.*LLM|FIXME.*generated|_unused[A-Z]|// removed|// DEPRECATED' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && echo '=========================='
